code:
# Build and push
docker build -t ghcr.io/yourusername/hello-cs357:0.1.0 .
echo $CR_PAT | docker login ghcr.io -u yourusername --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/yourusername/hello-cs357:0.1.0

# Teammate verifies (on their machine, not logged in to your account)
docker pull ghcr.io/yourusername/hello-cs357:0.1.0
docker run --rm ghcr.io/yourusername/hello-cs357:0.1.0
description: Five-step npm publishing: login, dry-run to review contents, publish with access public, verify with npx, ship fixes with npm version.

steps.description: Step 1: npm login once per machine with npm access token.
Step 2: npm pack --dry-run lists every file that would be included in the tarball.

title: npm Publish: Dry Run, Publish, Verify, Fix
